newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Macau grants land lease for ocean theme park.
newsitem.headline: Macau grants land lease for ocean theme park.

text.p: The Macau government has granted a 25-year lease for a 13-hectare reclaimed land to a local company for building an ocean theme park, which will display Macau's history as a portuguese settlement in China.

Chong Va - Entertainment Co Ltd would pay 10 million patacas and an annual rent of 809,346 patacas for the land lease, a government gazette said. The amount of rent would be reviewed every five years, it added.
Jose Cheong, general manager of Chong Va said total investment of the park to be built on reclaimed land off Taipa island facing the Macau Peninsula, will be 500 million patacas.
The park will have Macau's four-century old history as a Portuguese settlement in China as its main theme, Cheong said.
